a.xlink:title:
open_notebook.domain.acm.BuildingRecord
Domain model for Building records.
Represents a physical building extracted from SAMP documents. Maps to the Salesforce Building__c object with AliasChoices for dual BAR/SF field name support.
Linked to ACMRecords via acm_record.building_record_id FK.
